senses.gloss:
CRAB:
(1) कर्कटः;
(2) कुलीरः। C., i. e. c. -apple:
कपित्थः (?).

I Harsh, cross: q. v.
II Difficult,
perplexing: q. v.
CRABBEDLY: v. Peevishly; with difficulty.

CRABBEDNESS: v. Peevishness; roughness;
perplexity.

CRACK (v. i.):
I To break into pieces: q. v:
त्रुटति (त्रुट्, c. 6.).
II To rattle: q. v.: विरैति
(रु, c. 2.).
III To boast: q. v.

CRACK (v. t.):
I To break, burst: q. v.:
त्रोटयति (c. of त्रुट्).
II To snap: q. v.:
स्फोटयति, आ-, (c. of स्फुट्).
III To puff:
q. v. Ph.:
to c. a joke:
परिहासं करोति।

CRACK (subs.):
I Chink: छिद्रम्, c. in a wall:
भित्तिच्छिद्रम्, Mu. ii.
II A sound: q. v.:
विरावः।
III A crazy person: v. C.-brained.
IV A boaster: q. v.: विकत्थिन् (m).

CRACK-BRAINED: हतज्ञानः (ना, नं): v. Mad,
foolish.
CRACKER: a firework: *स्फोटकः।

CRACKLE (v. i.): चटचटायते (nomi.),
continuously
c. ing sesamum, white mustard seed, etc.:
निरन्तरचटचटायितान् तिलसिद्धार्थकादीन्, D.

CRACKLING (subs.):
I A rattle: q. v.: चट-
चटायितम्।
II The rind of roast pork: शूल्य-
शूकरमांसस्य त्वक्।
CRACKNEL: a kind of biscuit: *मुडमुडी।

CRADLE (subs.):
I Lit.: no equiv.: शिशूनां
 दोला: v. Swing. Ph.: from one's c.:
आ शैशवात्: v. Childhood;
an infant in the
c.:
क्रोडस्थः
or
स्तनन्धयः शिशुः
II Fig., abode:
q. v.: आवासः।

CRADLE (v. t.): लालयति (c. of लल्): v. To
nurse.

CRAFT:
I Art, occupation: q. v.: कला,
I
learnt it as a c., but it is my livelihood now:
कलेति शिक्षिता जोविकेदानीं संवृत्ता, Mr. ii.
II Cun-
-ning, artifice: q. v.: कौशलम्।
III A small
vessel:
(1) नौः;
(2) तरी।
CRAFTILY: चतुरम्: v. Cunningly.

CRAFTINESS:
(1) वैदग्ध्यम्;
(2) चातुर्यम्: v.
Cunning, artifice.
CRAFTSMAN: कारुः: v. Artisan, mechanic.

CRAFTY:
(1) विदग्धः (f. ग्धा);
(2) चतुरः (रा, रं):
v. Cunning.

CRAG:
I Rock, cliff: q. v.: कूटः।
II Neck: q. v.

CRAGGED, CRAGGY:
I Rugged, rough: q. v.
II Rocky: q. v.

CRAM (v. t.):
I To fill to excess:
c. med
with houses:
गृहसंबाधः (धा, धं), V. p.;
the forest
was c. med with the attendants of Śiva:
वनं
 गणैरविच्छेदनिरुद्धम्, K.;
c. ming the belly with
sweetmeats:
मोदकैः कुक्षिं पूरयित्वा, Mal.: v. To
fill, stuff.
II Of special instruction:
*विशेषशिक्षां ददाति (दा, c. 3.) (?),
c. mer
*विशेष-
शिक्षादातृ (m.).
CRAM (v. i.): *विशेषशिक्षां गृह्णाति (ग्रह्, c. 9.) (?).

CRAMP (subs.): A restriction: q. v.
II C.
-iron: वक्रलौहः (?).
III Spasm: q. v.

CRAMP (v.):
I To check: q. v.
II To
fasten: q. v.
III To afflict with c.: संकोचति
(कुच्, c. l.) (?). C. ed: v. Crooked.

CRANE:
I The bird:
(1) सारसः (the Indian
c.);
(2) कर्करेटुः (the Numidian c.).
II A
Machine for hoisting: *उत्तोलनयन्त्रम्।

CRANK:
I An iron elbow: वक्रभागः (?).
II
Bend, turning: q. v.
CRANNIED: छिद्रपूर्णः (र्णा, र्णं).
CRANNY: छिद्रम्।
CRAPE: वस्त्रविशेषः।
CRAPULENCE: महातङ्कः (?); अतिपानजनिता वमनेच्छा।

CRAPULENT, CRAPULOUS: भदविह्वलः (ला, लं)
(=drunk: q. v.).
CRASH (subs.): महाशब्दः: v. Sound, noise.

CRASH (v. t.): चूर्णयति (चूर्ण, c. 10.): v. To
break, crush.

CRASH (v. i.): महाशब्देन भज्यते (pass. of भञ्ज्): v.
To clatter.
CRASIS: in grammar: *संयोगः।
CRASS: v. Gross, thick.
CRATE: v. Basket.
CRATER: of a volcano: मुखम् (?).

CRAUNCH: दन्तैः निष्पीडयति (पीड्, c. 10.), B.:
v. To crush, chew.
CRAVAT: v. Neckcloth.

CRAVE:
I To beg, implore: q. v.
II To
long for: q. v.
CRAVEN: कापुरुषः: v. Coward.
CRAVING (subs.): लालसा: v. Longing.
CRAW: v. Crop. (II).
CRAWFISH, CRAYFISH: चिङ्गेटः (?); मत्स्यविशेषः।

CRAWL (v.):
I Of men:
(1) रिङ्गति (रिङ्ग्,
c. l.), they then used to c. about in the cowpen:
रिङ्गितौ तौ तदा व्रजे, V. p.;
(2) जानुभ्यां रंहति
(रंह्, c. l.), S.;
(3) जानुभ्यां कराभ्यां च भुवं संघृष्य
 सञ्चरति (चर्, c. l.), V. p. com.
II Of
animals: सर्पति, प्र-, (सृप्, c. l.). C. up to:
उपसर्पति।
CRAWLER: i. e. a crawling animal: सरीसृपः।
CRAYON: वर्तिका (=pencil); कठिनी (=chalk.)

CRAZE (v.):
I To crush, grind: q. v.
II
To confuse: q. v.

CRAZED, CRAZY:
I Decrepit, feeble: q. v.
II Mad: q. v.: क्षिप्तः (प्ता, प्तं).

CRAZINESS:
I Feebleness: q. v.
II Mad-
-ness: q. v.: क्षिप्तता।
